weekend_note: Showers and possible thunderstorms arrive Monday night, with the best rain chance (about 70%) on Wednesday, Thanksgiving Eve, so the Ice Flyers game at the Bay Center is the indoor pick that night. Thanksgiving Day is dry and cool (high near 60). Friday's Elf Parade and Saturday's Jingle Bells market look dry; the Motown Christmas show at the Saenger is indoors. Rain chances after Wednesday are estimates (10%) because the NWS point forecast does not list them.

news.title: Pensacola aims to finalize port lease with shipbuilder Birdon
news.summary: The Australian contractor now wants 16 acres instead of 10 at the Port of Pensacola; the city hopes to wrap up lease details by January, and a noise study still needs public discussion.

news.title: City and county to revisit Bay Center renovation talks
news.summary: Progress has been slow and no firm decisions exist; the county is seeking letters of interest from firms by Dec 9 and Chair Stroberger plans to meet the mayor next month.

news.title: New Escambia commissioners sworn in
news.summary: Mike Kohler (District 2) and Joe Vinson (District 4) took office Nov 17; Steve Stroberger became chair and Lumon May vice chair.

news.title: Pensacola Chamber leader Todd Thomson concludes a decade of service

news.title: UWF and Navy Federal offer small business recovery grants

news.title: Pensacola Beach Chamber names Christine Brewster CEO
